title: Future Funk Everywhere
style: future funk, disco house, deep house, 124 BPM, vocoder lead vocals, robot ad-libs, slap bass groove, syncopated synth stabs, filtered Rhodes chords, brass section hits, vinyl scratch accents, analog synth arpeggios, sidechain pumping, wide stereo mix, plate reverb, four-on-the-floor kick, claps on two and four, shimmering top end, celebratory release
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Vocoder, robotic voice, laser sounds, vinyl scratch, riser, boom)
"Song Pal Records... initiating sequence. Get ready for the groove."

[Verse 1]
(Oo-yeah!)
Lights low
City glow
Can you feel it?
(Feel it, baby!)
Digital soul
Taking hold
Ain't no concealing it
(No way, no way!)
Bassline thumpin'
Heart is jumpin'
(uh-huh!)
In this electric night
Somethin's always bumpin'

[Pre-Chorus]
Can you dig it
Can you dig it
The way we movin' free?
(So free!)
This rhythm's got a hold on me!

[Chorus]
Future funk
In the air
Everywhere!
(Oh, yeah!)
Deep house vibe
Can you feel the tribe
Everywhere!
(Come on, now!)
Disco dreams
Shiny gleams
Everywhere!
(Ain't no doubt!)
Got that future beat
Can't be beat
Everywhere!
(Everywhere!)

[Verse 2]
(Check it!)
Chrome and steel
How it feel
When the beat drops low?
(So low!)
Body swayin'
Ain't no playin'
Put on a real good show
(A real good show!)
Synth lines shimmer
Ain't no glimmer
Just pure gold
(Pure gold, honey!)
Stories in the rhythm
New tales to be told
